answer: A concrete defense is randomized review committees: for every submission the network draws its verifiers by public verifiable randomness, so nobody knows in advance which peers will judge their work. A sybil operator stacking the deck cannot place enough clones on a jury it cannot predict, and clone-heavy juries vote out of pattern and get discounted. Honest work reads like a sonnet, complete and unforced, while the clones whisper the same praise to one another, a repeated signal that plain statistics can hear.
